Fixes from the community since 4.17.2. Still built on upstream [v4.17.1](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.1).

### Fixes

- **`sst remove` no longer fails when a static site's asset bucket is already gone.** A missing bucket now counts as deleted, so an interrupted removal, or a bucket deleted outside SST, doesn't leave the stage half removed. ([#20](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/20), [anomalyco/sst#6963](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6963))
- **`sst dev` no longer restarts frontends every 50 minutes when they have no AWS credentials.** Only a process that gets credentials from a role is restarted, every 45 minutes, before they expire. ([#16](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/16), [anomalyco/sst#4264](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/4264))
- **A SvelteKit 3 site keeps its base path.** SvelteKit 3 renamed the manifest fields the component reads, so the base path was dropped with no error. ([#5](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/5))
- **Type-checking with `strict` no longer reports an error inside SST's `Function` component** (`TS18048` on the live description). ([#14](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/14), [anomalyco/sst#6915](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6915))
- **Generated `sst-env.d.ts` files end with a newline**, so editors and GitHub stop flagging them. Each one changes by that line the next time SST writes it. ([#12](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/12), [anomalyco/sst#6953](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6953))

### Changes

- `sst dev` runs `sst.aws.Task` with the fork's bridge image, `ghcr.io/sst-community/sst/bridge-task`, instead of SST's.
- Naming a component `App` now explains that the name is reserved for `Resource.App`. ([#10](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/10))
- Links in the CLI's help and error messages point at the fork's docs, [sst-community.github.io/sst](https://sst-community.github.io/sst/). ([#1](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/1))

### SvelteKit 3

SvelteKit 3 also needs a new adapter. The fork now publishes it as [`@sst-community/svelte-kit-sst`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sst-community/svelte-kit-sst) 3.0.0, which works with SvelteKit 2 and 3. Install it under the old name so `import adapter from "svelte-kit-sst"` keeps working:

```bash
npm install svelte-kit-sst@npm:@sst-community/svelte-kit-sst
```

([#6](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/6), [anomalyco/sst#6993](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6993))

### Docs

- Links to SST videos that are now private are gone from the docs and the component reference. ([#7](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/7), [#30](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/30), fixing [#4](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/issues/4) and [#29](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/issues/29))
- The React and TanStack Start docs say how to give `vite preview` your linked resources: run it with `sst shell`. ([#11](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/11))
- The Azure quick start no longer lists ACR geo-replication twice. ([#8](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/8))

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.3
```

To switch an existing project, set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.3"` and reinstall. Without Node:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
